The '''Mor Reesbon''' was the familial leader of the [[Reesbon clan]], one of the six controlling clans on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ammuud/Legends|Ammuud]]. The Mor Reesbon aligned himself with [[Gallandro/Legends|Gallandro]] in his plot against the [[Mor Glayyd]], in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]].
